results.title: YouTube is rated "Bad" with 1.5 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content: Looking at 967 reviews, most reviewers were let down by their experience overall. Consumer feedback reflects deep frustration regarding the excessive frequency, unskippable nature, and unreasonable length of advertisements that constantly disrupt everyday video viewing sessions. Customers frequently noted that constant website layout modifications, poor search functionality, and aggressive policie s make the platform increasingly difficult and exhausting to navigate. Some reviewers were happy with the platform, mentioning that there are still plenty of genuinely helpful and entertaining videos available to watch. A few users also noted that they enjoy discovering diverse content and truly appreciate the creative people who publish interesting material.See more [...] YouTube has become practically unusable, whether you pay or not. The amount of advertising is ridiculous. You can't even rewind a video without risking another advert. I paid for Premium Lite, then had to upgrade to Premium for music. I've paid for Premium twice this year and still found the experience frustrating. The search function is dreadful. Filters for upload dates and relevance barely work. Even searching for something simple like "puppies playing" brings up sensationalised rescue stories and irrelevant viral videos instead. The platform is flooded with AI-generated rubbish, misleading thumbnails, AI voice-overs and unwanted automatic dubbing. I'm fluent in English and Polish — I don't need videos automatically translated for me. Some creators with millions of subscribers also [...] YouTube increasingly prioritises advertising, algorithms and monetisation over its viewers. Premium doesn't fix the broken search, AI slop or irrelevant recommendations. I've practically given up on this platform now. It's become exhausting to use, even when paying for it.

# Send feedback

## Report a YouTube issue

1. Sign in to YouTube.
2. Select your profile picture  .
3. Select Send feedback.
4. Describe the issue you're experiencing. The more info you include in your report, the more helpful it is for us.
5. Choose if you want to include a screenshot. You can highlight info on the screen or remove personal info.
6. Click Send. [...] Make YouTube better | How to send feedback about YouTube from your computer

Subscribe to the YouTube Viewers channel for the latest news, updates, and tips.

## Smart TVs, Chromecast, and game consoles

1. Open the YouTube app on your device.
2. On the watch page of any video, select Settings .
3. Select Feedback.
4. Select the reason for your feedback.
5. Select Submit Report.

## How we use feedback

We appreciate the time that you spend sending us feedback. Your feedback goes directly to YouTube and we use it to troubleshoot issues, make product improvements and fix problems. Video creators do not see any feedback that is sent through the "Send Feedback" tool. While we may not reply to every report, we're reviewing and working to fix issues as fast as we can.
